ITEM 1 | Whole red-and-yellow apple with glossy skin, sitting on the lower-left of the plate, roughly 7 cm across and 6 cm tall, smooth shiny surface with a small stem-end dimple, firm and intact | 180
ITEM 2 | Two halved yellow citrus-like fruit pieces with bright yellow-orange rind, pale white pithy interior with a radial fibrous center, each half about 5-6 cm across and 3 cm tall, cut face exposed, sitting upper-left of the plate | 110
ITEM 3 | Florets of pale white cauliflower, dry matte surface with slightly textured bumpy florets, clustered on the right side of the plate, about 4-5 cm per floret with stems, no browning or sauce | 90
ITEM 4 | Scattered whole raw almonds, light tan to brown skins with a matte, slightly fuzzy surface, dry and separate, each about 2-2.5 cm long, forming a loose layer across the center and lower area of the plate | 120
